head.message: phys: implement local gravity and sign-flip negative mass contract

confirmed_provenance.author: tangleroot013 <tangleroot013@users.noreply.github.com>
confirmed_provenance.original_problem: The test expected flat STANDARD_G gravity while claiming to verify inverse-square local gravity.

physics_contract.test_expectation_strategy: Derive expected_magnitude independently from module constants; do not hardcode 686.46 or 687.3766.

tests/test_physics_contract.py.change: Expected value now derives from G_CONST, EARTH_MASS, and EARTH_RADIUS.

intended_changes: Preserved force rounding to four decimals
src/ez_grav.py.regression_risk: calculate_orbital_velocity() lost negative-altitude and positive-radius validation in the shown diff.

tests/test_ez_grav.py.status: Untracked canonical six-test file; inspect and intentionally add to Git.

required_next_steps: Commit the test correction and canonical test file separately or together intentionally.
do_not_do: Do not hardcode 687.3766 when the expected value can be derived from constants.
Do not stage src/ez_grav.py without reviewing its complete diff.
Do not stage backups, archives, handover scripts, or unrelated generated files.
Do not delete cleanup candidates until a green test baseline is committed.

next_architecture_candidate.priority: After baseline is green and committed
next_architecture_candidate.compatibility_requirement: Earth must remain the default body
